search_text: published ZDI-18-880 ZDI-CAN-5360 (Pwn2Own) Google Android UserCallActivity Null Pointer Dereference Denial of Service Vulnerability 2018-08-02 4.9 AV:L/AC:L/Au:N/C:N/I:N/A:C ['Google'] ['Android'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to force a reboot on vulnerable installations of Google Android. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of UserCallActivity. The issue lies in the failure to properly handle a NULL pointer dereference. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to force the device to reboot. title: (Pwn2Own) Google Android UserCallActivity Null Pointer Dereference Denial of Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to force a reboot on vulnerable installations of Google Android. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of UserCallActivity. The issue lies in the failure to properly handle a NULL pointer dereference. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to force the device to reboot.
